mapper.select: SELECT t.id, u.name, u.tel AS phoneNum, u.profileImg, t.approval_status AS approvalStatus FROM trainer t JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.gym_id = #{gymId} AND t.approval_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY t.id DESC
